"""Freeze actual checkpoint/failed-trace adoption without changing data or losses."""
import ast,shutil
from pathlib import Path
import torch,yaml
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');oldroot=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v1';root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v2';external=Path('/mnt/external/demosaic/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v2')
assert not root.exists() and not external.exists();prior=read(oldroot/'plan-v1.json');guard(prior)
failed=read(oldroot/'train-failure-v1.json');assert failed['progress']['last_completed_step']==915 and failed['progress']['counts']=={'legacy-control':915,'fine-mesh':915}
for name in ['launch-v1.json','queue-launch-v1.json']:
 assert not live(read(oldroot/name)['owner'])
assert not live(failed['owner'])
lines=(oldroot/'train-trace-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines();trace=[__import__('json').loads(s) for s in lines];assert len(trace)==915
baseline=read(prior['baseline_training']['path'])
for row,before in zip(trace,baseline['trace'][:915],strict=True):
 assert row['step']==before['step'] and row['batch']==before['batch']
 expected=before['arms']['bounded-support'];assert {k:row['arms']['legacy-control'][k] for k in expected}==expected
checkpoint=oldroot/'checkpoints/train-step0750.pt';state=torch.load(checkpoint,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
assert state['step']==750 and state['counts']==state['updates']=={'legacy-control':750,'fine-mesh':750}
from review_fine_mesh_trial import equal_tree
reference_checkpoint=Path(prior['previous'])/'checkpoints/train-step0750.pt';reference=torch.load(reference_checkpoint,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
for key in ['models','emas','optimizers']:assert equal_tree(state[key]['legacy-control'],reference[key]['bounded-support'])
assert all(float(s['step'])==750 and all(torch.isfinite(t).all() for t in s.values()) for o in state['optimizers'].values() for s in o['state'].values())
assert shutil.disk_usage(repo).free>56.75*2**30 and shutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free>116.5*2**30+prior['expected_new_quality_bytes_external']
root.mkdir(parents=True);external.mkdir();shutil.copytree(Path(prior['work']),root/'work')
source=repo/'.cache/resume_v168_fine_mesh_v1.py';text=source.read_text().replace('    journal.flush();last=750','    journal.flush();last=750\n    LIVE_PROGRESS.update(last_completed_step=750,adopted_prefix_steps=750)')
ast.parse(text);runner=root/'work/scripts/resume_v168_fine_mesh_v1.py';runner.write_text(text)
config=yaml.safe_load(Path(prior['config']['path']).read_text());before=dict(config)
config['external_root']=str(external)
config['scope']+=' Recovery:original local-disk guard stopped after915 complete updates;all old files/owners/receipts preserved. Resume actual step750 model/EMA/Adam/RNG,adopt750 prefix rows,and compare165 completed overlapping updates bitexact before finishing916..1000. No full-training restart. Actual head work becomes5638 roots/12688 images,including330 repeated recovery forwards/1320images;logical planned head work remains5308/11368. Fifteen recorded scientific owners include original failed train/controller/queue and new recovery/controller/queue. Model-stage resource failure1,dependent controller failures2,checkpoint recovery1;parent setup correction1 and read-only verifier correction1 remain separate. Gradient maxima are observed over smoke10 plus recovery751..1000,not global first1000 maxima;original source asserted all gradients finite.117 own procedural fixtures moved byteexact to SSD with original-path links,freeing1.257GiB;56/116GiB reserves stay fixed. Recovery durably checkpoints before waiting on any further resource guard. Data,model,objective,initializer,seed,optimization horizon and all quality inputs/endpoints stay unchanged.'
assert {k:v for k,v in config.items() if k not in ['scope','external_root']}=={k:v for k,v in before.items() if k not in ['scope','external_root']}
config_path=root/'work/configs/quality-v143-fine-mesh-ladder-v168-recovery-v1.yaml';config_path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(config,sort_keys=False))
artifact_names=['data-plan-v1.json','data-cache-result-v1.json','data-parent-flag-validation-v1.json','data-canonical-cache-v1.json','data-input-audit-v1.json','data-inspection-v1.json','data-actual-viewing-v1.json','data-inspect-owner-v1.json','data-cache-launch-v1.json','data-parent-flag-validation-launch-v1.json','data-parent-forward-events-v1.jsonl','data-parent-flag-validation-trace-v1.jsonl','smoke-result-v1.json','CPU-readiness-v1.json','quality-design-v1.json','candidate-pair-unit-table-v1.json','native-retained-comparators-v1.json','protocol-document-v1.md']
artifacts={}
for name in artifact_names:
 original=oldroot/name;target=root/name;shutil.copyfile(original,target);assert target.read_bytes()==original.read_bytes();artifacts[name]={'original':ref(original),'copy':ref(target)}
save(root/'prior-artifact-adoptions-v1.json',artifacts)
resume={'status':'actual750-checkpoint-and915-failed-trace-admission','checkpoint':ref(checkpoint),'reference_control_checkpoint':ref(reference_checkpoint),
 'original_training_journal':ref(oldroot/'train-trace-v1.jsonl'),'original_failure':ref(oldroot/'train-failure-v1.json'),
 'original_training_completion':ref(oldroot/'status-v1.json'),'original_queue_completion':ref(oldroot/'postprocess-status-v1.json'),
 'original_plan':ref(oldroot/'plan-v1.json'),'adopted_prefix_steps':750,'overlap_steps_to_verify':165,'new_updates_per_arm':250,
 'candidate915_state_not_retained':True,'no_claim_of_direct915-state-comparison':True,'all915_original_control_trace_rows_exact':True,
 'checkpoint750_control_model_EMA_Adam_exact_to_V167':True,'finite_restored_Adam_states':94,'fixture_relocation':ref(oldroot/'fixture-relocation-v1.json'),
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())}
save(root/'resume-adoption-v1.json',resume)
plan=dict(prior);plan.update(root=str(root),work=str(root/'work'),runner=ref(runner),config=ref(config_path),external_root=str(external),external_quality_root=str(external),
 quality_output_roots={f'{a}-{e}-step1000':str((root if a=='legacy-control' else external)/'review-v1') for a in config['arms'] for e in ['raw','EMA']},
 resume_adoption=ref(root/'resume-adoption-v1.json'),original_failed_root=str(oldroot),scope=config['scope'])
plan['inputs']=[*prior['inputs'],ref(oldroot/'plan-v1.json'),ref(root/'resume-adoption-v1.json'),ref(root/'prior-artifact-adoptions-v1.json'),ref(checkpoint),ref(oldroot/'train-trace-v1.jsonl'),ref(oldroot/'fixture-relocation-v1.json'),ref(config_path)]
plan['frozen_files']={str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in (root/'work').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
save(root/'plan-v1.json',plan);guard(plan)
save(root/'recovery-CPU-readiness-v1.json',{'status':'pass-actual-checkpoint-and-all915-control-trace-records','admission':ref(root/'resume-adoption-v1.json'),
 'all90_neural_sources_unchanged':True,'new_data_or_noise_calls':0,'loss_recipe_unchanged':True,'exact_restored_Adam_states':94,'exact_original_control_rows':915,
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'CUDA_initialized':torch.cuda.is_initialized()})
print('Prepared recovery root;915 original controls/actual750 model EMA Adam94 states verified;no NN work repeated yet')
